title: Name coverage versus working ownership
method: Synthetic inventory of 30 datasets. Operational coverage requires a named owner, a tested notification route and a correction process: 12/30 = 40%. Name-only coverage is a different and weaker measure.
alt: Name coverage versus working ownership. Operationally covered: 12 datasets; Name only: 10 datasets; No accountable owner: 8 datasets. Illustrative values.
